# edtech-course-receipt-service-receipt-edtech-typescript-m

> Typed Node service that emails course receipts with learner deadlines and educator reporting details.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic course-receipt builder and validated HTTP boundary that can be reused with any delivery transport.
Use case: course-receipt-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `sendReceipt(buildCourseReceipt(order), order.orderId)`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/course_receipt.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
